propositions: Gate format dual-encode must preserve both new pause metadata (paused, reason, who, paused_at with RFC3339 timestamps and git user.email provenance) and old gated_mode: reconcile-check vocabulary for backward compatibility with pre-change readers.

Pause operations must be idempotent and metadata-stable on same-reason re-pause, refuse without overwrite on blank/missing-identity/missing-remote/different-reason/CAS conflicts, and return rc 0 with exact anchored JSON-decoded BRIDGE_PAUSED marker before lock acquisition or ticket mutation.

Resume operations must perform observed-OID CAS deletion and safely recover from corrupt blob state without decoding it or emitting tracebacks, returning appropriate exit codes (rc 0 benign, rc 1 corrupt state).

Scheduled workflow must recognize only the complete rc-0 BRIDGE_PAUSED marker and skip commit-and-push; ordinary rc 0, malformed/unanchored markers, corrupt rc 1, and legacy gate rc 4 retain existing behavior without regressions.
Pre-gate reconcile-check early return and old rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary must remain functional with no rename of check_phase_gate and no removal of old vocabulary mappings.
